edges: Uptown Funk! leads the Hot 100 while Sugar is in second place.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Uptown Funk! is three weeks away from potentially tying One Sweet Day for the record.
Uptown Funk! surpasses Blurred Lines to take sole possession of the Hot 100's longest command this decade.
Uptown Funk! matches Low for the most weeks a title has spent at No. 1 on Digital Songs.
